description:
Space is hard on the human body. Our mission is to make it easier.
A smart health companion for astronauts, tracking sleep, stress, fitness and nutrition, so they can focus on exploring, while we take care of them.
summary: Health monitoring software dashboard which is linked with the devices that monitor the vitals and the wellbeing of astronauts. It simplifies all the data to the astronaut to understand it easily. It has a chat bot for the astronaut to use as the astronaut suffers from loneliness. And it has a scoring system to keep the astronaut hooked and makes taking care of their health like a friendly competition between astronauts.
details: AstroPulse by Team AéroSanté is a gamified Astronaut Health Dashboard. It collects astronaut input, vital signs, and lab tests like radiation, bone density, and muscle mass, and turns them into one simple Daily Health Score from 0 to 100. It uses Green / Yellow / Red alerts to warn astronauts early, and gives instant personalized recommendations for exercise, hydration, nutrition, and rest. Gamification with streaks, points, and badges keeps astronauts motivated. It was built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, using Figma, Canva, NASA open data, and Meta AI for research and design. Its impact is prevention, not reaction. It gives astronauts autonomy for Moon and Mars missions where Earth help is delayed, and can also help remote hospitals on Earth. AstroPulse protects astronauts before they get sick, not after.
